dedupe_keys.name: global multi hazard risk to port infrastructure and trade

description: This dataset holds the files created for Verschuur et al. (2022), "Multi-hazard risk to global port infrastructure and resulting trade and logistics losses", in Communications Earth and Environment. It comprises three folders: estimates of total port area for each port; a new port asset database with port assets, breakwaters and critical infrastructure within a 1 km buffer of each port; and risk outputs, including port-specific risk and trade risk overall and by hazard type. Readme files in each folder and subfolder describe the files, and the code to reproduce the results is on GitHub. Coverage is global, for ports worldwide. Access: free on Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0, published 2022-09-30. Caveats: risks are modelled from global hazard maps and generic vulnerability assumptions, so local detail may be missing. It supports hazard exposure and risk assessment of ports, prioritisation of port adaptation, and analysis of trade losses from port disruption, and complements the global port supply-chains and systemic climate risk datasets catalogued here.
name: Global multi-hazard risk to port infrastructure and trade
